node.title: Re^2: Possible redundant use of "use strict" and "use warnings"?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Perl remembers the modules already loaded (%INC) and does not load them again.

Yes, but to be nitpicky that's a feature of [doc://require] - [doc://use] is [id://1199713|equivalent] to BEGIN { require Module; Module->import( LIST ); }, meaning that multiple use statements will still cause the packages' ->import method to be called multiple times, which may make a difference if import does some nonstandard things.
